guide.name: Top of Search API v5 support

claims.text: v5 of the Pinterest API lets advertisers build and promote Top of Search campaigns via an API parameter.

evidence.locator: Top of Search ads with the Pinterest API

claims.text: Access to the Top of Search API parameter is gated: an account manager must grant access before use.
The mechanism is a campaign-level 'Top of Search' parameter set to true on the campaign creation endpoint.

evidence.locator: Set the 'Top of Search' parameter to true when setting up a new campaign.

claims.text: Calls to this parameter without account-manager-granted access are not usable; access is a precondition of the mechanism.

sections.summary: The evidence does not name use cases directly; the automation of Top of Search campaign creation via API follows from the documented capability.

claims.text: Advertisers building campaigns programmatically at scale can create Top of Search campaigns through the API rather than manual setup.
Step 1: contact your account manager to get access to the Top of Search API parameter.
Step 2: after access is granted, set the 'Top of Search' parameter to true when creating a new campaign on the campaign creation endpoint.

evidence.locator: Set the 'Top of Search' parameter to true when setting up a new campaign.

claims.text: Any further setup steps (e.g., request field names, defaults, or post-creation behaviour) are not described in the packet and are not reconstructed here.

sections.summary: The evidence describes only how to enable Top of Search campaigns via the API; no performance metrics, KPIs, or measured outcomes are provided, so no reporting or uplift claims can be made.

The packet contains a single evidence span about the Pinterest Top of Search API parameter and provides no information about other platforms' features, so no evidence-backed cross-platform relationship can be stated.

claims.text: Source: Pinterest Help Center, 'Top of Search ads' article (source_id: pinterest.search.top_of_search; URL: https://help.pinterest.com/en-gb/business/article/top-of-search-ads), covering both the v5 API usage and the account-manager access condition.
The packet does not include a check date for the source, so none is stated.
